value.rationale: A bounded class of impurity sites changes a perfectly matchable n-by-n bipartite substrate to a nondegenerate jamming vacancy distribution. Exact folded-binomial law for all fixed r and explicit finite-size rate are motivated observables, not isolated parameter substitutions. Two impurities cause asymptotic 50-percent defective outcomes despite vanishing impurity density.
